headline: 713 METRES OF GOLD-COPPER: DPM Metals Hits 2.52 g/t AuEq Next Door to Bulgaria's Chelopech Mine
snippet: DPM Metals (ASX:DPM) announced a major porphyry discovery at the Brevene South target in Bulgaria, with drill hole EX_BRESPO_03 returning 713 metres at 2.52 g/t AuEq (1.31 g/t Au, 1.16% Cu) from 1,172 metres depth — hole still open. The target sits one kilometre from the reserve boundary of the operating Chelopech gold-copper mine, with five rigs now dedicated to expansion drilling.

headline: ISS BACKS C$3B DEAL: Proxy Firm Urges G2 Goldfields Shareholders to Vote FOR G Mining Ventures Merger
snippet: Institutional Shareholder Services (ISS) recommended G2 Goldfields shareholders vote in favour of the C$3 billion acquisition by G Mining Ventures, calling the board process robust and the implied value transfer the best shareholders have seen since 2011. A special meeting vote is scheduled for June 16, 2026, at which point the deal to create a Tier-1 gold hub in Guyana moves to close.

headline: MINTO DELIVERS: Selkirk Copper Completes 52,000m Phase 1, Hits 4.39% Cu and 7.60 g/t Au, Assumes Site Control
snippet: Selkirk Copper wrapped up a 52,000-metre Phase 1 drill campaign at the historic Minto copper-gold-silver mine in Yukon, returning standout intercepts including 4.39% Cu, 7.60 g/t Au, 21.07 g/t Ag over 4.1 metres. The company has assumed full site responsibility and launched a 50,000m Phase 2 program, with 14,000 metres already drilled across 59 holes.

headline: DRILLS TURNING IN THE YUKON: Yukon Metals Kicks Off 5,000m Program at AZ and Birch Copper-Gold Targets
snippet: Yukon Metals Corp (CSE:YMC) has drill rigs active at both its AZ and Birch properties, targeting 5,000 metres of copper-gold exploration this season. First core was recovered at the AZ property on May 28, marking the start of the company's most ambitious field season to date.

headline: GOLD CAPS AT $4,500: ETF Selling and Ceasefire Optimism Stall the Rally as Key Support Watched
snippet: Gold rallied back to $4,500 per ounce on June 4 before stalling as US ETF outflows and a de-escalation in the Middle East — an Israel-Lebanon ceasefire deal sent oil prices lower — reduced safe-haven urgency. Spot settled near $4,479 with analysts watching $4,200 as the next meaningful technical support.

headline: SILVER HOLDS NEAR DECADE HIGHS AT $74/oz: Sixth Straight Deficit Year and Solar Boom Underpin the Metal
snippet: Silver held near decade highs around $74 per ounce as of June 4, 2026, sustained by persistent structural supply deficits and surging industrial demand from solar panel manufacturing. The metal has improved more than 150% over the past year and is now entering its sixth consecutive year of demand exceeding mine supply.

headline: REAL RATES AT ALL-TIME LOWS: GoldSeek Analysts Say the Gold Bull Market Thesis Is Strengthening, Not Fading
snippet: US real interest rates fell to all-time lows on June 5 as stagflation concerns deepen and the Dollar Index sits down 10.5% year-to-date — the textbook environment for sustained gold strength. GoldSeek notes CLSA upgraded its gold target to $4,840 for 2026 and $5,500 for 2028, while J.P. Morgan sees $6,000/oz as an end-2026 upside scenario.

headline: TRUMP TWEAKS COPPER TARIFF RULES: Section 232 Decision Due June 30, Goldman Assigns High Odds to 25%+ Duty
snippet: The White House updated its copper tariff rule framework ahead of the Commerce Department's June 30 deadline, when a recommendation on refined copper duties is due. Goldman Sachs assigns a high probability to a 25%+ tariff before mid-June. Comex copper futures are already trading more than $500 per tonne above LME spot as traders pre-position.

headline: URENCO USA EXPANDS ENRICHMENT BY 50%: Multi-Billion Dollar New Mexico Bet on U.S. Nuclear Fuel Independence
snippet: Urenco USA announced a multi-billion dollar expansion of its National Enrichment Facility in Eunice, New Mexico — the only commercial uranium enrichment plant in the US — adding 2.1 million SWU of new capacity using gas-centrifuge technology. Initial cascades come online in 2032, with full build-out through 2036, supporting up to 600 construction jobs at peak.

headline: RECORD MARGINS, NO LOVE: Gold Miners Printing $3,000+ Per Oz as GDX and GDXJ Stubbornly Lag the Metal
snippet: With gold above $4,400 and industry all-in sustaining costs below $2,000 per ounce, senior gold producers are generating margins the sector has never seen — yet GDX and GDXJ continue to underperform bullion in 2026. Analysts describe the setup as a classic contrarian opportunity, arguing the re-rating is overdue and equities will catch up sharply once the next leg higher begins.

headline: ENERGY STORAGE BECOMES LITHIUM'S SECOND PILLAR: AI Data Center Build-Out Adds Structural Demand Beyond EVs
snippet: Battery energy storage systems are emerging as a major standalone demand driver for lithium, accelerated by global investment in AI data center infrastructure and power grid upgrades. Mining.com notes this structural shift could rebalance a market that has been in surplus since 2023, with the deficit projected to arrive between 2030 and 2035.
